Description: AWS CloudFormation Template to create VPN services, contains 1 EC2 instance, 1 EIP and 1 security group. Also contains a nested template to create VPC resources.

Fn::Join: # Signal the status from cfn-init on EXIT
# AL2023 may not preinstall the cfn helper scripts; install is a
# no-op/update when they are already present.
# Install the files and packages from the metadata
# AL2023: docker lives in the core repos (amazon-linux-extras is AL2-only)
# AL2023 AMIs default to IMDSv2-required: fetch a session token first

# shadowsocks-rust ssmanager: supports the SS-2022 ciphers and the same
# multi-user Manager API as shadowsocks-libev's ss-manager. No --executable
# (servers run in-process); -U enables TCP_AND_UDP relay. v2ray-plugin is
# libev-only and not used here.
ss_docker_run_cmd_opts+=(-m $ss_encrypt -s 0.0.0.0 --timeout $ss_timeout -U)
docker run "${ss_docker_run_env_opts[@]}" --restart=always -d "${ss_docker_run_port_opts[@]}"
 --name ss-rust alexzhangs/shadowsocks-rust:$ss_version
 ssmanager "${ss_docker_run_cmd_opts[@]}"
# L2TP/IPsec runs containerized (libreswan + xl2tpd + bundled chap-manager);
# the legacy host install needed EPEL packages that AL2023 does not ship.
# --privileged + host network + /lib/modules: pppd needs /dev/ppp via the
# host's kernel modules, IKE/NAT-T must terminate on the host's UDP 500/4500,
# and the NAT rules for the client pool live in the host netns.

Properties.Description: Provide the Lambda interface for the shadowsocks-manager REST APIs.
Receive AWS Config events through SNS, and update Domain, Node and SSManager in shadowsocks-manager.
Maintain the node stack by receiving the SNS messages.
Slack slash-command handler for shadowsocks-manager node operations.

Architecture.Description: CPU architecture for the VPN server instance. Must be compatible with the chosen InstanceType (e.g. 'arm64' for t4g.* / a1.* / m6g.* etc., 'x86_64' for t2/t3/m5/etc.). Default is 'x86_64'.

VpcCidrBlock.Description: Enter CIDR Block for VPC. Default is '10.30.0.0/16' (65536 IPs).
VpcCidrBlock.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.

AdminAllowedCidr.Description: CIDR allowed to reach the administrative surfaces: SSH (22), the shadowsocks-manager web UI (80) and TLS UI (443). Defaults to 0.0.0.0/0 for backward compatibility, but SET THIS to your admin/bastion CIDR (e.g. 203.0.113.4/32). Does NOT affect the public VPN service ports (Shadowsocks, L2TP) which must stay open to clients.
AdminAllowedCidr.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.

EnableVpcPeerAcceptor.Description: Whether to create VPC peer acceptor resource. 0: no, 1: yes. Default is '0'.

VpcPeerAcceptorStackTemplateURL.Description: VPC peer acceptor stack template URL, must be an AWS S3 URL.

VpcPeerRequesterAccountIds.Description: Used with EnableVpcPeerAcceptor=1. Comma-separated 12-digit AWS account IDs of the node (requester) accounts allowed to assume the peer role and send to the route queue. Passed to the acceptor stack's PeerRequesterAccountIds. The acceptor template requires it (no default there), so leaving this empty fails the acceptor deploy closed instead of trusting every AWS account.

EnableVpcPeerRequester.Description: Whether to create VPC peer requester resource. 0: no, 1: yes. Default is '0'.

VpcPeerRequesterStackTemplateURL.Description: VPC peer requester stack template URL, must be an AWS S3 URL.

VpcPeerAcceptorVpcId.Description: VPC ID of the VPC peer acceptor.

VpcPeerAcceptorRegion.Description: Region code of the VPC peer acceptor.

VpcPeerAcceptorRoleArn.Description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the VPC peer role of acceptor.

VpcPeerAcceptorCidrBlock.Description: CIDR Block of the VPC peer acceptor.
VpcPeerAcceptorCidrBlock.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.

VpcPeerAcceptorSqsQueueUrl.Description: SQS queue URL of the VPC peer acceptor.

SubnetCidrBlocks.Description: Comma-delimited list of CIDR blocks for subnets. Default is '10.30.0.0/24, 10.30.1.0/24, 10.30.2.0/24, 10.30.3.0/24' (256 IPs each).
SubnetCidrBlocks.ConstraintDescription: The single CIDR block must be a valid IP CIDR range of the form x.x.x.x/x.

EipDomain.Description: Switch the value between '' and 'vpc' to refresh EIP. The EIP assigned out of stack won't be deleted on stack delete. Default is 'vpc'.

InstanceType.Description: Enter a Instance Type. Default is 't2.micro'.

KeyPairName.Description: Enter Key Pair name. Default is 'myhosts'

EnableSSN.Description: Whether to install Shadowsocks server. 0: no, 1: yes. Default is '1'.

SSV2Ray.Description: Whether to enable v2ray plugin for Shadowsocks server. 0: no, 1: yes. Default is '0'. Only applies to the 'libev' edition.

SSEdition.Description: The Shadowsocks server edition. 'libev' (shadowsocks-libev-v2ray) for the classic ciphers; 'rust' (shadowsocks-rust) for the Shadowsocks-2022 ciphers (e.g. 2022-blake3-aes-256-gcm). When 'rust', set SSEncrypt to a SS-2022 method. Default is 'libev'.

SSVersion.Description: Enter the version (Docker image tag) of the selected Shadowsocks edition image (shadowsocks-libev-v2ray or shadowsocks-rust). Default is 'latest'.

SnsTopicArn.Description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of SNS topic.

EnableSSM.Description: Whether to install Shadowsocks manager. 0: no, 1: yes. Default is '1'.

EnableL2TP.Description: Whether to install L2TP server. 0: no, 1: yes. Default is '1'.

SSPortBegin.Description: Begin port allowed to use for Shadowsocks server. Default is '8381'.

SSPortEnd.Description: End port allowed to use for Shadowsocks server. Default is '8385'.

SSDomain.Description: Domain name resolved to Shadowsocks server. Example: ss.example.com

SSDomainNameServerEnv.Description: Environment variables required to use the DNS API service for SSDomain.

SSManagerInterface.Description: Network interface bound to Shadowsocks Manager API on the node. 1: Localhost, 2: Private, 3: Public. Default is 2

SSManagerPort.Description: Port number bound to Shadowsocks Manager API. Default is 6001

SSEncrypt.Description: Encrypt method for Shadowsocks server. Default is 'aes-256-gcm'.

SSTimeout.Description: Socket timeout in seconds for Shadowsocks server. Default is 60.

DomainNameServerEnv.Description: Environment variables required to use the DNS API service for SSMDomain, SSDomain and L2TPDomain.

SSMAccountId.Description: AWS Account ID of the owner of the Shadowsocks manager stack.

SSMDomain.Description: Domain Name resolved to Shadowsocks manager. Example: admin.ss.example.com.

SSMDomainNameServerEnv.Description: Environment variables required to use the DNS API service for SSMDomain.

SSMAdminUsername.Description: Username for Shadowsocks manager administrator. Default is 'admin'.

SSMAdminPassword.Description: Password for Shadowsocks manager administrator. Default is 'passw0rd'.

SSMAdminEmail.Description: Email address for Shadowsocks manager administrator. Will be shown as contact in account notification Email.

SSMVersion.Description: Enter the version of shadowsocks-manager. Default is 'latest'.

L2TPDomain.Description: Domain Name resolved to L2TP server. Example: vpn.example.com.

L2TPDomainNameServerEnv.Description: Environment variables required to use the DNS API service for L2TPDomain.

L2TPPassword.Description: Password to connecting to L2TP server. Default is 'passw0rd'.

L2TPPrimaryDNS.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP v4 address like x.x.x.x.

L2TPSecondaryDNS.ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IP v4 address like x.x.x.x.

EnableConfigConsumer.Description: Specifies whether SNS topic and Lambda function should be created, to handle the change events of AWS Config services. If you set EnableSSM=1, then you should set this option to '1'. The default is '0'.

EnableConfigProvider.Description: Specifies whether AWS Config services should be set up to notify EC2 instance changes so that the instance can be auto-registered into Shadowsocks manager. If you set EnableSSN=1, then you should set this option to '1', but only set once in one AWS account. If you have already set up AWS Config in the account, then set this option to '0'. The default is '0'.

ConfigProviderStackTemplateURL.Description: Config Provider stack template URL, must be an AWS S3 URL.

EnableSlackBot.Description: Specifies whether the Slack slash-command bot should be set up so that node operations (e.g. change IP) can be invoked from Slack. Requires EnableSSM=1. The default is '0'.

SlackSigningSecret.Description: Slack app Signing Secret (from the app's Basic Information page). Required when EnableSlackBot=1; used to authenticate inbound slash-command requests.

SlackAllowedUsers.Description: Optional CSV of Slack user IDs allowed to invoke the bot (e.g. 'U123,U456'). Empty disables the user allowlist.

SlackAllowedChannels.Description: Optional CSV of Slack channel IDs where the bot may be invoked (e.g. 'C123,C456'). Empty disables the channel allowlist.

VpcStackTemplateURL.Description: VPC stack template URL, must be an AWS S3 URL.

SlackBotUrl.Description: Register this URL as the Request URL for the /vpn slash command in your Slack app's Slash Commands configuration.
